Write your paper with an AI editor

Drop a PDF, Markdown, HTML, text or image file here, or a saved .lpdoc project.

AI editor

Select words in a paragraph and press Ask AI (Alt+A); pick a request such as Better logical flow, or type your own. The answer comes back in place as tracked changes, or labelled Rewrite when it changes a lot. Tab accepts, Esc rejects, Ask again sends it back with extra instructions.

Each document keeps one chat: the AI gets the whole paper once, then each request with its paragraph. Use your own Claude (Anthropic) key, another AI, or the demo mode with no key.

Now: Demo mode (no AI)

What you can do

  • Word-style editing: fonts, sizes, headings, lists, tables, images, footnotes, contents, symbols
  • Page width: A4, Letter, wide, any width (drag the page edge) or fill the whole window
  • Offline spell check in English (UK) or (US), with lab and medical terms; F7 steps through
  • Word's keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+/ lists them); word count; format painter; change case
  • Highlights and comment bubbles; export to PDF, HTML or Markdown; autosaves in this browser
  • Open a PDF and turn it into an editable document; open Markdown, HTML or web pages
